components.name: button
components.description: The primary interactive element with multiple variants, sizes, and states.

components.name: icon-button
components.description: A square button for icon-only actions. Requires an accessible label — renders sr-only text or aria-label.

components.name: link
components.description: A styled anchor component with external link detection and icon support.

components.name: input
components.description: Text input with validation state and icon element support.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with auto-resize, validation state, and min/max rows.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Binary selection control with indeterminate support. Built on Radix UI Checkbox.

components.name: switch
components.description: Toggle control for binary on/off state. Built on Radix UI Switch.

components.name: label
components.description: Accessible form label built on Radix UI Label. Clicking it focuses the associated control.

components.name: select
components.description: Accessible custom select with keyboard navigation, groups, and scroll buttons. Built on Radix UI Select.

components.name: combobox
components.description: Searchable single-select with type-to-filter, keyboard navigation, keywords, clearable selection and native form support. Built on Popover and Command.

components.name: badge
components.description: Small status indicator or label with 10 semantic color variants and 3 sizes.

components.name: avatar
components.description: User avatar with image, fallback initials, and 6 size variants. Built on Radix UI Avatar.

components.name: card
components.description: Surface container with header, body, and footer compound components.

components.name: dialog
components.description: Modal overlay with focus trap, scroll lock, and animation.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Contextual hint shown on hover/focus. For non-interactive supplementary content only.

components.name: popover
components.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger. Supports all placement sides. Built on Radix UI Popover.

components.name: alert
components.description: Inline status messages with semantic variants and auto-selected icons.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Animated loading indicator with 4 sizes. Renders with role='status' and a sr-only label.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Placeholder loading state with pulse animation. Use it to match the shape of the content it replaces.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Tabbed navigation with keyboard support and full ARIA. Built on Radix UI Tabs.

components.name: accordion
components.description: Vertically stacked collapsible sections with keyboard navigation. Built on Radix UI Accordion.

components.name: stack
components.description: Vertical or horizontal flex container with consistent gap and alignment props.

components.name: typography
components.description: Semantic heading and body text components with correct HTML elements and token-driven styles.

components.name: radio
components.description: Radio button group for single selection. Built on Radix UI RadioGroup.

components.name: form-field
components.description: Wraps any form control with a label, helper text, and error message. Handles ARIA wiring automatically.

components.name: slider
components.description: Range input with keyboard navigation, multiple thumbs for range selection, and 3 sizes.

components.name: flex
components.description: Low-level flex container with full control over direction, wrap, align, justify, and gap.

components.name: grid
components.description: CSS Grid container with column count, gap, and auto-responsive variants.

components.name: container
components.description: Max-width wrapper with centered horizontal padding. Responsive size variants.

components.name: box
components.description: Generic layout primitive — a div with no opinions. Use when none of the semantic layout components fit.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.description: Constrains children to a specific aspect ratio. Built on Radix UI AspectRatio.

components.name: spacer
components.description: Invisible element that pushes siblings apart. Renders aria-hidden. Prefer gap when possible.

components.name: tag
components.description: Dismissible label chip with 4 visual variants and 3 sizes. Optional onDismiss for removable tags.

components.name: progress
components.description: Linear progress bar with 4 color schemes and 4 sizes. Built on Radix UI Progress.

components.name: empty-state
components.description: Zero-data placeholder with icon, title, description, and optional CTA slot.

components.name: toast
components.description: Accessible notifications with 5 variants, auto-dismiss, and imperative API via useToast().

components.name: drawer
components.description: Side panel overlay from left, right, top, or bottom. Shares the Dialog accessibility contract.

components.name: hover-card
components.description: Preview card revealed on hover for sighted users with pointing devices. Built on Radix UI HoverCard.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: Floating context menu with items, submenus, checkboxes, and radio groups. Built on Radix UI DropdownMenu.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: Navigation trail showing hierarchy. Uses <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> and structured list markup.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Page navigation with prev/next, page number buttons, and ellipsis for large page counts.

components.name: scroll-area
components.description: Custom scrollbar with consistent cross-browser styling. Built on Radix UI ScrollArea.

components.name: command
components.description: Command palette with fuzzy search, keyboard navigation, and modal mode. Powered by cmdk.

components.name: table
components.description: Semantic HTML table with styled header, body, footer, and row selection state.
